scope: Two assembled player outfits: a girl and a boy. This is not the complete set of game character customizations.

outfit.description: Warm ivory ditsy-floral dress with dusty coral wildflowers, butter-yellow centers and sage leaves; warm rose lining and taupe legwear.
outfit.processing: Custom floral albedo replaces the original grayscale cloth map. Original mesh, UVs, skeleton and skin weights unchanged. Embedded PNG, 512 × 512, no additional runtime image requests.

pattern.prompt: Seamless small ditsy floral cotton texture, warm ivory ground, dusty coral and muted terracotta five-petal wildflowers, butter-yellow centers, subdued sage leaves. Naturally scattered spacing, approximately 8–10 flower motifs across the tile. Soft hand-painted game textile, uniform flat albedo, no folds, lighting, shadows, seams, borders, text or logos.

players.name: 小男孩
players.differences: Original short side-parted PlayerHair08 mesh, short-sleeved striped T-shirt mesh and cargo-shorts mesh. Shared original PlayerBody with the existing girl; this is an outfit choice, not a different body type.

conversion.tools: nintoolbox wmdlt and wszst for original BFRES meshes and BNTX textures; Three.js GLTFLoader and GLTFExporter for assembly.
conversion.jointCorrection: Original BFRES rotations use ZYX radians. The intermediate converter incorrectly treats them as degrees; restore each Euler angle in ZYX order before binding.
conversion.rig: PlayerBody skeleton retained; clothing meshes rebound to shared body bones, short hair attached to Head.
conversion.textures: Original striped T-shirt albedo recolored cream and sage, original cargo-shorts albedo retained; all textures embedded. Hair curve texture tinted dark brown.

outfit.description: Cream and sage striped T-shirt with khaki cargo shorts and warm brown legwear.
outfit.processing: Original shirt stripe pattern recolored with preserved shading and antialiased edges; original khaki shorts, mesh, UVs, skeleton and skin weights unchanged.
